description: This is an abstract class 'RawPage' within the 'Todaymade\Daux\Format\Base' namespace. It implements the 'Page' interface and provides common properties and methods for handling files, including constructor, getFile, and placeholder methods getPureContent and getContent that throw exceptions.

classes.name: RawPage
classes.description: An abstract class that models a raw page in the documentation generator, providing file handling and placeholder content methods.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the RawPage with a filename.

methods.name: getFile
methods.description: Returns the filename associated with this page.

methods.name: getPureContent
methods.description: Method intended to return the pure content of the page, but throws an exception indicating it should not be used directly.

methods.name: getContent
methods.description: Method intended to return the content of the page, but throws an exception indicating it should not be used directly.
